meta.description: Italy NPK recommendations for 12 crops (14 records; olive and grapevine per-tree/per-vine + per-ha; grapevine uses existing 'grape' item) - user-supplied data (2026-10-13) with Italian research sources (CREA, Emilia-Romagna, Veneto, BETA, ENR). All source values already per-hectare.

records.applicationTiming: Full P/K basal (concimazione di fondo); N in 2-3 top-dressings.
records.applicationMethod: Concimazione di fondo: full P2O5 and K2O basally. N split into 2-3 top-dressings at fine accestimento (tillering) and levata (stem elongation).
records.notes: N 140-180, P2O5 50-70, K2O 40-70 kg/ha. Common wheat (grano tenero, Pianura Padana).
records.source_org: CREA (Consiglio per la ricerca in agricoltura)
records.source_org_2: Disciplinari di Produzione Integrata, Regione Emilia-Romagna

records.applicationTiming: Starter band (NP 18-46); side-dress N at 6-8 leaves with earthing-up.
records.applicationMethod: Starter NP 18-46 band at planting; N side-dressed at 6-8 leaves with earthing-up (sarchiatura). P2O5 and K2O basally.
records.notes: N 180-240, P2O5 70-95, K2O 100-160 kg/ha. High-yielding grain maize (mais da granella).

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K and 40% N before submersion; top-dress at tillering and panicle differentiation.
records.applicationMethod: Basal P2O5 and K2O plus 40% N before submersion; N top-dressed at tillering and panicle differentiation.
records.notes: N 100-140, P2O5 40-60, K2O 60-90 kg/ha. Rice (riso, Piemonte & Lombardia).

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; 2-3 N top-dressings, late at botticella/spigatura for protein.
records.applicationMethod: Basal P2O5 and K2O; 2-3 N top-dressings with late application at botticella/spigatura (heading) for protein quality.
records.notes: N 110-150, P2O5 50-70, K2O 30-50 kg/ha. Durum wheat (grano duro, Foggia/Sicilia).

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; spring top-dress N at tillering.
records.applicationMethod: Basal P2O5 and K2O; N top-dressed in spring at tillering.

records.applicationTiming: P/K at seeding; N at stem restart.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O at seeding; N applied at stem restart.
records.source_org: CREA (Consiglio per la ricerca in agricoltura)

records.applicationMethod: All fertilizer placed 100% basally at seedbed preparation.
records.source_org: Disciplinari di Produzione Integrata, Regione Emilia-Romagna

records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O incorporated pre-plant; starter N only (0-20 kg). Seed inoculated with Bradyrhizobium.
records.notes: N 0-20, P2O5 40-60, K2O 50-80 kg/ha. Soybean (soia, second/first crop).

records.applicationTiming: P/K autumn-winter; N pre-seeding or split at 4-leaf stage.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O applied in autumn/winter; N applied pre-seeding or split at the 4-leaf stage.
records.notes: N 90-130, P2O5 60-80, K2O 100-160 kg/ha. Sugar beet (barbabietola da zucchero).
records.source_org: BETA (Societa di Ricerca e Sperimentazione Bieticola)

records.applicationTiming: 50% N + full P/K at bed ridging; 50% N at rincalzatura.
records.applicationMethod: 50% N plus full P2O5 and K2O at bed ridging; remaining 50% N during rincalzatura (earthing up). SOP (chloride-free) preferred for processing/DOP quality.

records.applicationTiming: Split from ripresa vegetativa (March) to allegagione (June); post-harvest K.
records.applicationMethod: Intensive orchard per-hectare dose. Split from ripresa vegetativa (March) to allegagione (June); post-harvest potassium.
records.notes: N 70-110, P2O5 30-45, K2O 90-140 kg/ha. Intensive olive orchard (olivo).

records.applicationTiming: Per-tree dose in spring; traditional orchards.
records.applicationMethod: Source-faithful per-tree dose: N 500-900 g, P2O5 200-350 g, K2O 600-1000 g per mature tree per year. Numeric per-hectare values estimated at ~100 trees/ha standard density; always state the per-tree dose first. Applied in spring.
records.notes: N 500-900 g, P2O5 200-350 g, K2O 600-1000 g per mature tree/year (olivo).

records.applicationTiming: Moderate N to prevent excessive vigor; split post-budbreak and post-harvest.
records.applicationMethod: Per-hectare dose for quality wine target. Moderate N to prevent excessive vigor; split post-budbreak and post-harvest. Source-faithful per-vine dose: N 15-25 g, P2O5 8-12 g, K2O 20-35 g per vine/year (~3000 vines/ha).
records.notes: N 40-70, P2O5 20-35, K2O 60-90 kg/ha. Wine grapevine (vite da vino) per hectare.

records.applicationTiming: Per-vine dose applied in spring; quality wine target.
records.applicationMethod: Source-faithful per-vine dose: N 15-25 g, P2O5 8-12 g, K2O 20-35 g per vine per year. Numeric per-hectare values estimated at ~3000 vines/ha standard density; always state the per-vine dose first. Applied in spring.
records.notes: N 15-25 g, P2O5 8-12 g, K2O 20-35 g per vine/year (vite da vino).
